repos.name: cheaper-inference/OmniRoute
repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 359 providers (150+ free), 1200+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by hundreds of contributors
repos.one_liner: A unified, free MIT-licensed AI gateway providing access to over 359 model providers and 1200+ LLMs through a single endpoint.
bullets: Built with TypeScript, acting as a high-performance proxy/gateway for LLM API requests.
Aggregates 150+ free providers alongside major commercial models like Claude, GPT, and DeepSeek.
Designed for seamless integration with developer tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and Cline.
Enables developers to switch models dynamically without changing infrastructure code.

repos.name: ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search
repos.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
repos.one_liner: An agentic framework built on Claude Code that automates the end-to-end job application process locally.
bullets: Python-based framework leveraging Claude Code for autonomous task execution.
Automates CV tailoring, cover letter generation, and interview preparation based on specific job postings.
Runs locally on the user's machine to ensure privacy and ownership of application data.
Ideal for professionals looking to scale their job search efforts using agentic workflows.

repos.name: microsoft/skill-recorder
repos.description: Desktop app that records your on-screen work session and uses the GitHub Copilot SDK to reconstruct it as an intent + ordered steps, then builds a reusable Skill or Automation for Microsoft Autopilots like Scout, Microsoft Copilot Cowork, or Copilot Studio.
repos.one_liner: A desktop application that captures on-screen workflows and converts them into reusable automation skills via the GitHub Copilot SDK.
bullets: TypeScript-based desktop application utilizing the GitHub Copilot SDK for intent recognition.
Records user interactions to reconstruct structured steps and logic for automated tasks.
Outputs reusable 'Skills' compatible with Microsoft Autopilots for enterprise workflow automation.
Reduces manual effort in creating complex automation scripts by capturing human intent in real-time.

repos.name: google-gemini/gemini-cli
repos.description: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
repos.one_liner: An open-source AI agent that integrates Gemini's multimodal capabilities directly into the terminal environment.
bullets: TypeScript-based CLI tool providing direct access to Gemini's LLM capabilities.
Enables terminal-based agentic workflows, allowing users to execute complex tasks via natural language.
Supports multimodal inputs, making it useful for developers managing infrastructure or code via CLI.
Facilitates rapid interaction with AI models without leaving the command-line interface.

repos.name: hugoj0s3/NaturalCron
repos.description: Human-readable schedule expressions for .NET (C#): write "every day at 9am except sunday" instead of cron. Time zones, fluent builder, custom keywords, cron converter.
repos.one_liner: A .NET library that allows developers to define complex scheduling expressions using natural language.
bullets: C# fluent builder library that parses human-readable strings into standard cron expressions.
Supports advanced scheduling features including time zones, custom keywords, and complex recurrence patterns.
Provides a robust infrastructure component for fintech applications requiring precise, readable job scheduling.
Eliminates the maintenance burden of cryptic cron syntax in enterprise .NET systems.
